title: Migrants from the Netherlands to Pella, Iowa, 1846-1880
descriptions: The dataset was created for research on the Hollandisch roots of Pella Dutch in Iowa. The dataset is a prosoprography of 2660 Dutch migrants who emigrated to Pella, Iowa in the period of 1846 to 1880.
